description: Patients none of whose lab records has an RA result of '-'.

d.request: Select the 10 patients having no lab records with RA result of '-', ranked by highest average hematocrit, displaying patient ID, average uric acid, and average hematocrit, with patients lacking hematocrit values last, ignoring missing values in averages and not rounding.
d.sql: SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.UA), AVG(l.HCT) FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID ORDER BY AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10;

b.request: Patients who have no lab record with RA result of '-'
b.sql: SELECT p.* FROM Patient p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.RA = '-')
b.raw: Patients who have no lab record with RA result of '-'

c.request: Looking only at patients without a rheumatoid factor (`RA`) result of '-' in their lab tests, which 10 have the highest average hematocrit (`HCT`) across all their lab records? Show patient `ID`, average uric acid (`UA`) and average hematocrit, highest first, with patients who have no hematocrit values last. Ignore missing values in the averages and don't round. Patients none of whose lab records has an RA result of '-'.
c.sql: SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.UA) as avg_ua, AVG(l.HCT) as avg_hct FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: Among patients none of whose laboratory records has a rheumatoid factor (`RA`) result of '-', list the 10 with the highest average hematocrit (`HCT`) across all their lab records. Show patient `ID`, average uric acid (`UA`) and average hematocrit, highest hematocrit first, with patients who have no hematocrit values last. Averages ignore missing values. Don't round.
a.sql: SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.UA) AS avg_ua, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_hct FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10
